calculator.description: 34-digit Decimal arithmetic using numeric literals and allowed operations/functions only: + - * / ^ including fractional powers; unary ln/log (natural), exp, sqrt. No symbols, assignments or equations. Units are not inferred: result unit is null and unit_inference is not_performed. Convert and verify physical units explicitly.

sympy.description: AST-whitelisted real-symbol algebra. Declare all symbols including variable. Constants pi/E; unary ln/log/exp/sqrt/sin/cos/tan/asin/acos/atan/sinh/cosh/tanh/abs. Solve expression=0 without '=' syntax. Identity false means NOT PROVEN, never automatic inequivalence/grading failure; review domains separately.

reference_db.description: Lookup one externally mounted private reference record preserving original value/units/conditions/source labels; returns database SHA256 and separate review_warnings. Source labels are not independent verification.

reference_id.description: Common IDs: universal_gas_constant_si, eryomin_gas_constant_j_mol_k, eryomin_avogadro_constant, calorie_to_joule_molar, atmosphere_to_pascal, torr_to_pascal. Other IDs require the private index supplied by the operator.
